'''The End of the World''' was the most popular [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Koda Space Station|Koda]]. Along with [[Mammon Hoole]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] meet up with outlaw [[Karkas]] in the cantina before meeting him again in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].
